text:
maria: starting single thread to track Azure GPU account enablement + quota + smoke tests for Dedicated pools. putting everything in one place.

maria: TL;DR
- subs: prod-sub: a1b2-xxxx-prod, ded-sub: c3d4-xxxx-ded
- regions: westeurope (primary), eastus2 (fallback)
- skus: Standard_ND40rs_v2 (A100-80), Standard_NC24rs_v3 (V100)
- request: ND40rs_v2 -> 6 each sub, NC24rs_v3 -> 4 each sub
- extra: AcceleratedNetworking, NetworkInterfaces, subnet IPs -> 256
- SR: SR#991122334 (quota), SR#991122335 (capacity reservation)

ashley: paste SR link + confirm billing contact please, also are these for Dedicated pools or just quota headroom?

maria: SR link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/SupportRequestBlade/rep=support/SR991122334
Billing contact: finance@redwood.com
This is for Dedicated pool onboarding. We'll request reservations after quota validates deployability.

sanket: include these quota items explicitly in the SR comment: "AcceleratedNetworkingPerSubscription", "NetworkInterfaces", "IPv4SubnetIPs" (or equivalent), and ask for StandardNetworkvCPUs if they prompt. Azure tends to gate NICs separately.

jin: past failure note: Support rejected one request because subscription didn't have correct EA enrollment attached. @maria make sure enrollment ID + PO attached in SR.

maria: enrollment ID attached and PO referenced in SR comment.

infra-bot: tracking sheet updated: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Example/edit#gid=0  (row added, owner @maria, SR#991122334)

leo: quick q — do we want VMSS tags now so billing shows correctly? tag keys: cost-center, team, env. ops will need that when provisioning.

sanket: yes tag VMSS/LB. Also note: quota unlocks provisioning, but capacity reservation is separate and can take 48-72h to approve.

maria: plan: 1) push quota request SR#991122334 now, 2) smoke deploy one ND + one NC in westeurope after approval, 3) open reservation SR#991122335 if smoke ok, 4) automate pool creation and tagging.

ashley: share the ARM snippet we'll use for the smoke VM so ops can run it quickly.

maria: pasted ARM snippet in SR comment and here for convenience:
```
{
  "type": "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines",
  "apiVersion": "2021-07-01",
  "name": "gpu-smoke-nd40-test",
  "location": "westeurope",
  "properties": {
    "hardwareProfile": { "vmSize": "Standard_ND40rs_v2" },
    "networkProfile": { "networkInterfaces": [{ "id": "/subscriptions/a1b2.../nic/gpu-smoke-nic" }] }
  }
}
```

maria: added explicit request: subnet IPs -> 256 per subnet, AcceleratedNetworking -> enabled, NIC quota increase. put exact SKU/region/sub IDs in SR.

azure-support-bot: SR#991122334 updated: "Initial request received. Need enrollment validation + billing confirmation. Processing 1-3 business days. Ref INC-555001".

jin: pinged finance for enrollment proof. will post screenshot when received.

ashley: small ask — request NIC accelerated networking flag quota and ask for a soft-test: allow one test VM create before full approval if possible. speeds validation.

sanket: agree, add note: "Please allow provisional deploy for smoke test (1xND,1xNC) to validate network features before full reservation".

maria: added that comment to SR.

azure-support-bot: SR#991122334 update: "Quota change applied for westeurope: Standard_ND40rs_v2=6, Standard_NC24rs_v3=4 for subscription a1b2-xxxx-prod. Eastus2 pending capacity review."

maria: can someone try the smoke deploy in westeurope now? I'll monitor logs.

ashley: running smoke deploy now.

ashley: deploy output: "Provisioning succeeded: gpu-smoke-nd40-test" :tada:

ashley: verified NIC shows AcceleratedNetworking enabled and observed expected link metrics during boot.

maria: great. i'll file capacity reservation SR#991122335 for 6 ND40rs_v2 + 4 NC24rs_v3 in westeurope. linking it here.

infra-bot: added SR#991122335 (CAP-777888) to tracking sheet and linked to the row for a1b2-xxxx-prod.

azure-support-bot: SR#991122335 created: "Capacity reservation request received. ETA 2-4 business days. Reference CAP-777888".

jin: reminder: after reservation approval ensure our autoscaler is pinned to reserved quota to prevent accidental scaling into shared infra and getting preempted.

sanket: noted — will add autoscaler guard and run canary in staging.

maria: update: finance uploaded EA enrollment screenshot to SR. waiting on EastUS2 capacity confirmation; if EastUS2 unavailable we'll plan longer model sync windows and change routing policy.

leo: cost note — fallback to eastus2 may increase egress costs ~0.4-1.0c/GB depending on customer region. ops/product should be aware.

maria: final: I'll follow up once reservation SR updates. keeping this thread pinned. thanks all.

azure-support-bot: SR#991122334 closed: "Quota change completed for westeurope. EastUS2 escalated to Capacity Planning team — awaiting availability."
